$comment: Runtime supply registry: runtimes bundled by each agent DevKit is installed into. Maintained manually — agent-bundled runtimes live inside the agents' own distributions and cannot be observed from GitHub. Update on agent upgrades and refresh lastVerified. Detection hints help humans re-verify.

workbuddy.detectionHint: WorkBuddy managed Node installs under %USERPROFILE%\.workbuddy\binaries\node\versions\<version> (directory name contains the Node version); does not write to system PATH.

officeace.detectionHint: Bundled Node reported by the OfficeAce platform team; re-verify on agent upgrades.

codearts-ide.detectionHint: CodeArts IDE bundled Node reported by the platform team; re-verify on agent upgrades.

codearts-desktop.detectionHint: CodeArts Desktop bundled Node reported by the platform team; re-verify on agent upgrades.
